<div class="card-body">
'''Collision!''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">衝突！</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1フォース消費して、相手の宇宙戦闘機が2機以上いる星系に対して使う。運命数を引く。運命数＜相手の宇宙戦闘機の数ならば、どれか一つが失われる（相手が選ぶ）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-74o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">高速での衝突は、宇宙戦闘機同士での乱戦には付き物である。探知機は妨害され、パイロットは視覚のみに頼らざるをえないため、事故の確率が増すのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Collision!

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force at a system where the opponent has at least two starfighters. Draw destiny. If destiny < the number of those starfighters, one is lost (opponent's choice).

'''Lore:''' High-speed collisions are part of starfighter dogfights. Sensors are jammed and pilots have to rely on sight, so the chance of accidents rises.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names starfighters; the English names starships.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Collision!]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
